Expansion PanelContainment

The `m3e-expansion-panel` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Standalone panels

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel []
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] } [] [ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel>
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

Standalone panels (2)

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.open True ]
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] } [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.open True ] [ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withOpen True
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel open>
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

Toggles

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.togglePosition M3e.Values.before
, M3e.ExpansionPanel.toggleDirection M3e.Values.horizontal
]
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.togglePosition M3e.Values.before
, M3e.ExpansionPanel.toggleDirection M3e.Values.horizontal
]
[ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withTogglePosition M3e.Values.before
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withToggleDirection M3e.Values.horizontal
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel toggle-position="before" toggle-direction="horizontal">
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

Toggles (2)

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.hideToggle True ]
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] } [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.hideToggle True ] [ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withHideToggle True
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel hide-toggle="">
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

API

Types

type Is

The kind row m3e-expansion-panel produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ToggleIconSlot

The kinds the toggle-icon slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type ToggleDirection

The toggleDirection values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type TogglePosition

The togglePosition values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

M3eComponentsBuilderRaw

Constructor

expansionPanel : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.Is s) admittedBy msg

The loose m3e-expansion-panel producer — open attribute/child rows, no required record. See M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.component for the required-content form.

Advanced

Motion durations and state-layer opacities — raw CSS custom-property overrides for the 16 transition-timing tokens and 3 interaction-state opacity tokens @m3e/web exposes.

CSS Variables

Non-color @m3e/web CSS custom properties (typescale, shape, motion, state), grouped by name hierarchy. Color tokens live in the Color section. Type a value to override it; clear it to revert. Live default values are not shown — Elm cannot read computed CSS variables.
